entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Flux installed pgo 5.8.6 into fern. This is the last release Helm recorded as deployed.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: The OCIRepository picked up pgo 5.8.7 (semver 5.*) and Flux upgraded the release. Helm recorded the upgrade as failed.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: fern-databases stopped reconciling because fern-operators was not Ready. fern-apps followed at 15:41. Both have stayed blocked since.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: The upgrade to 5.8.8 failed the same way.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Flux started the 5.8.9 upgrade. The new operator pod started on 5.8.9 within a second and is still the running pod, so the chart did roll out.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Helm stopped waiting after five minutes: "context deadline exceeded". Release v4 was marked failed.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: The new operator rolled the fern-pg pods: repo host at 20:05, both instances by 20:06. All three have been ready since, with no restarts.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Flux stopped retrying the release. From 16:57 fern-operators has reported HealthCheckFailed on every reconcile.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Spotted while reading the cluster's Warning events: fern-operators has failed its health check 103,785 times since 31 August. Nobody had picked it up.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Everything that runs is healthy: pgo 1/1 on 5.8.9, fern-pg 2/2 instances, fern-api 1/1, fern-worker 9/9, and no events in the fern namespace. What failed is Helm's record of the release.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Git main is at f18a671 and all four fern Kustomizations last applied that revision, so nothing is waiting to deploy today. The next change under .infra/databases or .infra/apps will not roll out.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Proposed, not run: check that the 5.8.9 objects match the chart, then have Flux retry the release once (flux reconcile helmrelease pgo -n flux-system --force). Needs an owner and a decision.

followups.text: Get pgo back to Ready so fern-operators, fern-databases and fern-apps reconcile again.
Give HelmRelease pgo an explicit spec.timeout and upgrade remediation, so a slow upgrade is retried instead of stalling.
Alert when a Flux Kustomization stays not Ready for more than a day. This one went unseen for eight months.
Decide whether pgo should follow every 5.* release automatically or be pinned and bumped on purpose.

title: pgo upgrade stuck, fern rollouts blocked
